title: Zhang Heng's seismoscope
summary: The Han polymath Zhang Heng built what many historians consider the first seismoscope; it showed the direction of an earthquake about 500 km away.
why: The earliest known instrument to detect distant earthquakes.

notes.problem: Date: record uses Zhang Heng's lifespan; source dates the seismoscope to 132.
Source hedges: 'what many historians consider ... the first seismoscope'.
